text: Led development of a booking platform with 10+ distinct designs and drove OKRs to establish a new revenue stream.
Automated deployment process with CI/CD, cut time from months to less than 10 minutes and ensured zero downtime.
Refactored E2E tests and designed 35+ Cypress tests, enhanced pipeline efficiency, performance and reliability.
Architected a pixel-perfect UI with Atomic Design, utilized Storybook with 1,000+ tests for high quality and scalability.
